name: Custom Wedding Guest Book with Led Lights
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted with high-quality, durable materials:
    - Layer 1 & 3: 3mm acrylic
    - Layer 2: 5mm wood
    - Acrylic Charms: 3mm acrylic
  • Included Accessories:
    This product comes with:
    - 1 canvas drawstring bag for storing the acrylic charms
    - 1 wooden base for stable display
    - 1 wooden box for storage (requires self-assembly)

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    Available in multiple sizes to suit your event:
    12 × 12 inches ~ 30.48 × 30.48 cm
    14 × 14 inches ~ 35.56 × 35.56 cm
    16 × 16 inches ~ 40.64 × 40.64 cm
    18 × 18 inches ~ 45.72 × 45.72 cm
    20 × 20 inches ~ 50.8 × 50.8 cm
    22 × 22 inches ~ 55.88 × 55.88 cm
    24 × 24 inches ~ 60.96 × 60.96 cm
    Note: Dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design.

 

  • Wooden Box Options for Storage (Assembled Size):

- 7.87 × 5.9 inches ~ 20 × 15 cm: Suitable for guest book sizes ranging from 12 in to 16 in

- 9.84 × 7.87 inches ~ 25 × 20 cm: Suitable for guest book sizes ranging from 18 in to 24 in

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Printed using advanced UV printing for vivid, high-resolution designs that are resistant to fading. Both sides of the product are printed for a polished finish.

 

  • Functionality Use:
    This guest book is a creative and luminous alternative to traditional sign-in books. Guests write their names or messages on the acrylic star-shaped charms and drop them into the frame.
  • Includes LED lights, powered by USB
    - Two switch types available: one for monochrome lights and one for 7-color changing modes.
    - Great as a nightlight or keepsake decoration after the event.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:
    Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, or milestone celebrations. A meaningful gift for couples or families to cherish special memories forever.
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Wedding Guest Book with Led Light, 1x Wooden Box, 1xCanvas Drawstring Bag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
